data.one_liner: Display WhatsApp & Instagram-like stories or inline feeds with playback gestures.
data.what_it_does: Displays customizable stories containing text, images, GIFs, and videos with built-in navigation gestures like pause, forward, and rewind. It can be used fullscreen or inline within lists and columns.
use_when: You need to build Instagram or WhatsApp style stories into your application.
You want to display inline story items inside lists or columns like a news app.
avoid_when: You require complex social network backend features; this package only handles the UI and playback viewing component.
strengths: Supports still images, GIFs, and video playback with caching
Includes touch gestures for pause, rewind, and forward out of the box
Provides animated progress indicators for each story item
weaknesses: Limited to story viewing components and may require custom UI styling to match specific design systems.
